annotations.title: Monthly rateable value changes by council

description: How the rateable values the Valuation Office AMENDED in one month moved, for one council (billing authority) by name or code, or a short list of every council (name, code, number amended, % change) if neither is given. Covers only the properties amended that month, not the whole council, and one month is never a trend: call it for several months to see a direction. Always read pct_change with n_amended, top1_share_pct and median_mover_pct; pct_change is null when not publishable, and rankable=false means do not rank the place against others. For £ per m², property counts or overpaid shares across a council, use area_breakdown instead. Costs 1 credit.

ba_code.description: Council code, e.g. '1835'. Alternative to council.

council.description: Council name or part of it, e.g. 'Birmingham'.

include.description: Optional extra sections for the answer. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.include_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored. Leave out unless the user asks for something the normal answer lacks.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Omit for the latest complete month.

options.description: Optional extra settings by name. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.options_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored.

name: get_area_statistics
